testFuzz_floor_firstTimerAndCompletingEx.notice: First-timer: reverts iff amount > remaining (ExceedsGoal) or (amount < floor and not completing). forge-config: default.fuzz.runs = 512

testFuzz_floor_repeatFunderAnyAmount(uin.notice: Repeat funders may add any amount > 0 (up to the remaining goal), regardless of floor / creator min.

testFuzz_slots_cannotOccupyAllSlotsWitho.notice: Economic property: however the adversary fills, using first-time funders each paying min(floor, remaining), the pot is complete after at most 256 distinct funders. forge-config: default.fuzz.runs = 24

test_slots_256FloorFundersCompleteExactl.notice: 256 distinct first-time funders, each paying exactly the floor, complete the pot exactly. The 257th distinct funder can only hit ExceedsGoal (remaining == 0). NOTE: Kitty's `TooManyContributors` check in fund() is defense-in-depth. It is UNREACHABLE through the public flow for Open pots: occupying 256 slots requires 256 first-time payments, each >= effectiveMin >= ceil(goal/256) (only the final completing payment may be smaller), so totalFunded would already equal goal, and ExceedsGoal is checked first (before the slot check).

test_slots_nonMultipleGoal_completesWith.notice: Non-multiple goal: 250 funders at the floor (4) leave 1 unit; one more first-timer completes with 1.
